title: Work memories: propagate continuation invalidation across HTTP
outcome: Consolidated Codex reviewer session-7009 Low at src/work_memories.rs:241. Distinguish invalid receipt errors from transient transport errors across HTTP; discard only invalidated source data. Include actual HTTP-shape UI/route regression and preserve partial lists for genuine 429/502 transport failures. Merge non-progress continuation test follow-up here.
